summary: Angled bays in a bush-edged university car park, with homes over 35 m away.
reasons: Car park with cars already parked

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto bush and university buildings; the nearest mapped dwellings are 36 m or more away, across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Open from the road, with marked angled bays and a wider sealed apron.
drivers.traffic: Quiet campus car park, some daytime comings and goings.
drivers.convention: Other cars are parked in the bays, so a van will not stand out.

flags: University car park, may be patrolled or time-limited
sun_shade: Partly shaded by tall trees, mainly from the north and west.

best_section.where: Angled bays at the top of the small car park off Discovery Drive
